audit: 2026-09-15 scheduled remote agent (third fire of the day): one 50-question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-15_c_1.json through _c_5.json, ten questions per file because the MCP publish path carries file content inline. Tier split 24 L3, 22 L4 and 4 L5 with no L2; module split Paediatrics 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 12, Psychiatry 13, Medicine 12, taking every module to exactly 1561 and the bank to 6244. Cell selection: the live matrix showed L3 sitting 12.1 to 14.8 points and L4 sitting 11.3 to 13.7 points below their per-topic ideals while L5 sat at 5.04 per cent in all four modules, so a strict per-question argmax is degenerate at this bank size and this is the fourth consecutive fire to record it. Simulated directly it placed 40 of 50 questions in Paediatrics L3 and Obstetrics L3, allocated nothing to Psychiatry or Medicine, and would have widened the module spread from 2 to 40. This fire allocated proportionally to the positive within-topic deficits at roughly 52:48 L3 to L4, capped per-module counts so all four modules land on the same total, and placed one L5 in each module, which is the minimum holding every module at or above 5.00 per cent after adding 12 to 13 non-L5 questions. The routine prompt's per-question selection section should be rewritten as a proportional allocation with an explicit module-balance cap and an L5 floor rule. Duplicate control: scripts/dupe_gate.py flagged one question (a febrile neutropenia item duplicating sched-0915a-med-002, which the keyword screen missed because the earlier batch wrote the neutrophil count in words), and it was replaced with an inflammatory myopathy item. A manual comparison against the a and b batches published earlier today then found eight further conceptual duplicates that the gate scored below threshold because the subtopic_detail wording differed while the condition and the correct action were identical: pulled elbow, congenital muscular torticollis, nasal foreign body, benign nocturnal limb pains, listeriosis in pregnancy, varicella exposure in pregnancy, depersonalisation derealisation disorder and clozapine gastrointestinal hypomotility. All eight were replaced outright in the same cell and with the same answer letter, and the gate was re-run clean on the final 50. Recommend the gate be extended to compare stems as well as subtopic_detail, since wording-level novelty is not conceptual novelty. Coverage added, chosen from ground the bank had not touched: Paediatrics on umbilical granuloma, unsettled infant crying, umbilical hernia, prepubertal vulvovaginitis, laryngomalacia with faltering growth, threadworm household treatment, positional plagiocephaly versus lambdoid synostosis, distal radial buckle fracture, toe walking with a positive Gowers sign, achondroplasia craniocervical stenosis, beard distribution haemangioma with subglottic involvement, right sided varicocele and obstructed total anomalous pulmonary venous drainage where prostaglandin is harmful; Obstetrics and Gynaecology on Turner syndrome, breast lump triple assessment under 35, overactive bladder, retained vaginal foreign body, non classical congenital adrenal hyperplasia, prolactinoma, carbimazole to propylthiouracil in the first trimester, valproate found in the second trimester, polyhydramnios with normal glucose tolerance, postmenopausal bleeding on tamoxifen, post-term choriocarcinoma and warfarin dosing with a mechanical mitral valve; Psychiatry on depersonalisation replaced by fitness to drive for a commercial driver, antidepressant sexual dysfunction, St John's wort interactions, blood injection injury phobia, mirtazapine after drug induced hyponatraemia, intermittent explosive disorder, repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation eligibility, functional seizures, isotretinoin associated depression, valproate hyperammonaemic encephalopathy, serotonergic antidepressant bleeding risk on dual antiplatelet therapy, adolescent gaming masking social anxiety and modified release paracetamol overdose; Medicine on inflammatory myopathy with malignancy screening, achalasia, eosinophilic oesophagitis, ACE inhibitor unmasking renal artery stenosis, Paget disease of bone, recurrent Clostridioides difficile, amiodarone induced thyrotoxicosis type 2, thyrotoxic periodic paralysis, Wilson disease, IgA nephropathy, multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 and septic shock with severe aortic stenosis.
